episodes.synopsis: Taiyo faces school chaos as Bronze Rank spy Sosuke Michibata targets him with sabotage and rumors.
episodes.title: Winners and Losers

episodes.synopsis: Shinzo’s shopping trip with Ayaka turns chaotic as Kengo and Nanao secretly assist him.
episodes.title: The Big Bro Shinzo Safety Watch Team

episodes.synopsis: Taiyo faces Shinzo in a brutal game of tag during the first stage of the Spy Exam.
episodes.title: Spy Advancement Exam

episodes.synopsis: Taiyo faces Kyoichiro in a terrifying final exam stage where examinees vanish into the darkness.
episodes.title: The Fruit of Love

episodes.synopsis: Taiyo meets a mutated Kawashita to learn how to kill Tsubomi, but his father-in-law, Momo, appears.
episodes.title: New Cherry Blossoms

episodes.synopsis: Mutsumi tests Taiyo’s surging powers while Futaba fails to learn tech skills from Shion.
episodes.title: At the Old Yozakura Residence

episodes.synopsis: Ai goes on her first solo errand to cheer up the family, while a disguised Taiyo and Mutsumi follow.
episodes.title: Ai's Errand / Mutsumi's Major Diet Mission

episodes.synopsis: The Yozakuras' search for an ancient journal turns into a chaotic and revealing mansion cleanup.
episodes.title: Tsubomi & Mutsumi

episodes.synopsis: Kyoichiro vanishes, but Taiyo’s date is cut short by a mysterious presence and an urgent summons.
episodes.title: Refusal

episodes.synopsis: Taiyo finds Kyoichiro, who rejects the family and flees, causing a rift among the siblings.
episodes.title: Operation Search for the Eldest Son

episodes.synopsis: Poisoned by Tsubomi, Kyoichiro flees to save his family. Taiyo desperately chases him to save him.
episodes.title: Let's Be a Family Again

episodes.synopsis: The series of incidents involving the former Yozakura heads turn out to part of Momo's plot to resurrect his beloved wife, Rei. As he whispers about his twisted love for his family, Momo vanishes from Mutsumi and the others' sight. Meanwhile, Kyoichiro, who was saved by Taiyo's Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers, returns home to his siblings. The touching reunion is short-lived, as in order to make him reflect after trying to sacrifice himself to protect the family, a "Day of Family Service" begins! What lies in store for Kyoichiro is his siblings' merciless requests... Just then, a message arrives for Mutsumi.
episodes.title: Family Restaurant Meeting With Dad

episodes.synopsis: Under Mutsumi's orders, Kyoichiro and Taiyo pursue the fleeing Momo. Taiyo manages to land a punch on Momo once, but the gap in abilities between himself and Momo, who can hold his own against Kyoichiro, is all too clear, and he's left on the defensive. On top of that, numerous Dark Cherries - creatures birthed by Tsubomi, which feed on humans as nutrients - appear, blocking the way. Taiyo launches another attack, but he falls just short, letting Momo get away. Kyoichiro destroys the Dark Cherries, and is about to take Taiyo back with him to Mutsumi, when he's suddenly summoned by the chairman of the Spy Association, Kai Izumo...
episodes.title: The Gold Rank Spy Meeting

episodes.synopsis: Taiyo and the others learn that the Spy Association HQ has been rigged with bombs. They have less than an hour before they explode! They must stop them, or the ensuing drastic accident will involve legitimate society as well. The intruders have the ability to shape-shift into staff members or spies, and led by Kai, the Gold Rank spies split up to search inside the HQ. Taiyo, along with Ryu and Shinzo, visit the Training Wing, where the children living at the HQ are hard at work. The kids come running when they see Ryu, and soon they're having a lively conversation, but... ?!
episodes.title: Objectives

episodes.synopsis: Futaba and Shinzo have vanished from the Yozakuras’ sight. To get their abducted siblings back, Mutsumi and the others regroup, but Futaba and Shinzo’s inexplicable actions have left them visibly upset. Then one day, Shion sends Taiyo on an errand to the Gaon Mall with Kengo. But Taiyo and Kengo soon find themselves surrounded by spies whose simmering resentment towards the Yozakura family is nearing the boiling point, thanks to Momo! They’re on the brink of a brawl when a woman shows up. One word from her, and the fight is stopped…
episodes.title: Making Soba Noodles
